description: Defines intrusive smart pointer classes (intrusive_ptr and weak_intrusive_ptr) and related utilities for reference counting and memory management within the c10 namespace, used in PyTorch for efficient object lifetime management.

classes.name: intrusive_ptr_target
classes.description: Base class for objects managed by intrusive_ptr, supporting reference counting, resource release, and optional PyObject preservation.

classes.name: intrusive_ptr
classes.description: Intrusive smart pointer for managing objects inheriting from intrusive_ptr_target, with support for reference counting, ownership transfer, and custom allocation.

classes.name: weak_intrusive_ptr
classes.description: Weak counterpart to intrusive_ptr, allowing non-owning references that can be upgraded to strong references if the object still exists.

methods.name: make_intrusive
methods.description: Creates a new intrusive_ptr by constructing a TTarget object with provided arguments.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps two intrusive_ptr or weak_intrusive_ptr instances.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Comparison operator for intrusive_ptr or weak_intrusive_ptr based on raw pointer addresses.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for intrusive_ptr or weak_intrusive_ptr based on raw pointer addresses.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality operator for intrusive_ptr or weak_intrusive_ptr based on raw pointer addresses.

methods.name: reclaim
methods.description: Creates an intrusive_ptr from an owning raw pointer without increasing refcount.

methods.name: reclaim_copy
methods.description: Creates a new intrusive_ptr from an owning raw pointer, increasing refcount.

methods.name: unsafe_steal_from_new
methods.description: Wraps a raw pointer into an intrusive_ptr without ownership transfer.

methods.name: unsafe_adapt_non_heap_allocated
methods.description: Creates an intrusive_ptr for a non-heap-allocated object, initializing refcounts directly.

methods.name: unsafe_reclaim_from_nonowning
methods.description: Creates an intrusive_ptr from a non-owning raw pointer, assuming it is already owned.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Attempts to upgrade a weak_intrusive_ptr to a strong intrusive_ptr if the object still exists.

methods.name: use_count
methods.description: Returns the number of strong references to the object.
